nodes.description: Registry contract holding addresses of all protocol components (core, data provider, fee provider, liquidation manager).
Address of the LendingPoolCore contract that holds all funds and reserve state.
Address of the LendingPoolDataProvider used for health-factor and balance computations.
Address of the parameters provider supplying flashloan fees and borrow-size limits.
Fee provider used to compute loan origination fees.
Owner address controlling privileged configuration functions.
Mutex counter enforcing the nonReentrant modifier.
Mapping of reserve address to ReserveData (indexes, rates, flags, aToken address).
Nested mapping user => reserve => UserReserveData (principal, rate mode, timestamps).
Array of all reserve addresses registered on the core.
Principal balances of aToken holders.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.
Total principal supply of aTokens.
Revision number of the last initialization; guards re-initialization.
Flag set while an initializer is executing.
Address of the underlying reserve asset represented by the aToken.
Last liquidity index at which each user balance was accrued.
Mapping of user to the address receiving redirected interest.
Balances whose interest is redirected to a given address.
Allowances permitting third parties to redirect a user's interest.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding the implementation address.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding the proxy admin address.
Mapping of bytes32 key to stored component address in the addresses provider.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, ownership and balance accounting.
Miner-influenced timestamp driving interest accrual and event metadata.
Original transaction sender; dangerous if used for authorization.
delegatecall to an implementation/liquidation manager executing untrusted code in proxy storage context.
Low-level call with value and fixed gas forwarding ETH to arbitrary addresses.
Inline assembly sstore writing the implementation/admin slot without Solidity safeguards.
Arithmetic on balances, indexes, fees and iterations (SafeMath-guarded or unchecked).
Interest and index computation derived from block.timestamp minus lastUpdateTimestamp.
Inline assembly sload reading the implementation/admin slot directly.
Deposits a reserve asset, mints aTokens and transfers funds to the core.
Redeems underlying asset for an aToken holder; callable only by the aToken.
Borrows from a reserve after collateral, health-factor and rate-mode checks.
Repays a borrow wholly or partially, including origination fees, on behalf of a user.
Swaps a user borrow between stable and variable interest rate modes.
Rebalances a user's stable borrow rate when market conditions change.
Enables or disables a deposit as collateral after health-factor checks.
Liquidates an undercollateralized position via delegatecall to the liquidation manager.
Provides uncollateralized liquidity that must be returned plus fee within one transaction.
Initializer wiring addresses provider, core, data provider, parameters and fee provider.
Updates reserve and user state after a borrow, only callable by the lending pool.
Updates reserve and user state after a repayment, only callable by the lending pool.
Updates principal and collateral reserve state after a liquidation.
Transfers ERC20 or ETH (low-level call with gas) to a user.
Pulls ERC20 via safeTransferFrom or accepts ETH from a user to the reserve.
Transfers fees to the token distributor in ERC20 or ETH.
Accounts for flashloan income and compounds it into the liquidity index.
Updates indexes, interest rates and collateral flag after a deposit.
Updates indexes and interest rates after a redeem.
Sets the useAsCollateral flag of the user reserve data.
Initializes a new reserve, only callable by the configurator.
Payable fallback that only accepts ETH from contracts.
Recomputes liquidity/stable/variable rates and stamps lastUpdateTimestamp.
Moves principal between stable and variable total borrows on rate-mode changes.
Fallback entrypoint delegating to the implementation.
Performs the delegatecall to the implementation and bubbles results.
Admin-only upgrade that delegatecalls arbitrary data on the new implementation.
Writes the implementation address to the EIP-1967 slot using sstore.
Writes the admin address to the EIP-1967 slot using sstore.
Reads the admin address from the EIP-1967 slot using sload.
Initializes implementation, admin and init data on the proxy.
Initializes the implementation and delegatecalls init data.
Creates a proxy for a component or upgrades it via upgradeToAndCall.
Overridden ERC20 transfer gated by the whenTransferAllowed health check.
Burns aTokens and triggers redemption of the underlying from the pool.
Cumulates both parties' balances, updates redirected balances and performs the transfer.
Mints accrued interest as new aTokens and refreshes the user index.
Redirects the interest of a user to a target address and rebalances redirected balances.
Self-service redirection of the caller's interest stream.
Grants an address the right to redirect the caller's interest.
Computes the interest-inclusive aToken balance including redirected balances.
Mints aTokens on deposit; restricted to the lending pool.
Aggregates user liquidity, collateral, borrows, fees, LTV and health factor across reserves.
Checks whether a balance decrease keeps the health factor above the liquidation threshold.
Computes the health factor from collateral, borrows, fees and liquidation threshold.
Compounded interest formula raised to the power of the elapsed seconds.
Linear interest formula based on the elapsed time since the last update.
Computes the compounded borrow balance using stable or variable cumulative indexes.
Internal balance transfer updating sender and recipient balances.
Internal mint increasing total supply and account balance.
Internal burn decreasing total supply and account balance.
Public ERC20 transfer from msg.sender to a recipient.
Public ERC20 transferFrom deducting the caller allowance.
Checked addition that reverts on overflow.
Checked subtraction that reverts on underflow.
Checked multiplication that reverts on overflow.
Multiplies two ray values, rounding half up.
Divides two ray values, rounding half up.
Mutex modifier incrementing and verifying the guard counter around execution.
Modifier restricting execution to the current owner.
Modifier preventing repeated initialization of a proxy implementation.
Low-level call to a token with optional return value handling.
Owner-only transfer of contract ownership.
Owner-only renunciation of contract ownership.
Caller-supplied flashloan receiver contract address.
Caller/admin-supplied calldata delegatecalled during upgradeToAndCall.
Address written to the implementation slot during an upgrade.
Caller-supplied borrow amount.
Address on whose behalf a repayment is made.
Reserve address whose underlying is being redeemed.
Effective redeem amount, replaced by the total balance when UINT_MAX_VALUE is passed.
Liquidity snapshot taken before a flashloan disbursement.
Snapshot of the guard counter inside the nonReentrant modifier.
Computed repayment amount including origination fees in repay().
Health factor recomputed after a prospective balance decrease.

edges.reason: deposit attributes the deposit and aToken mint to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
redeemUnderlying receives the user address derived from the aToken caller context.
borrow evaluates collateral and health factor for msg.sender.
repay uses msg.sender for authorization when repaying on behalf of another user.
swapBorrowRateMode operates on the caller's borrow position.
setUserUseReserveAsCollateral applies to the caller's own deposit.
liquidationCall is permissionless and identifies the liquidator by msg.sender.
flashLoan is permissionless; the receiver executes with caller-supplied parameters.
ERC20 transfer moves tokens from msg.sender.
transferFrom spends the msg.sender allowance of the sender account.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
Ownable constructor sets the deployer (msg.sender) as owner.
deposit triggers updateStateOnDeposit on the core.
deposit forwards the asset to the core through transferToReserve.
deposit mutates reserve accounting inside the core.
deposit emits block.timestamp in the Deposit event.
deposit is guarded by the nonReentrant mutex.
redeemUnderlying triggers updateStateOnRedeem on the core.
redeemUnderlying pays the user through transferToUser.
redeemUnderlying emits block.timestamp in the RedeemUnderlying event.
redeemUnderlying is guarded by the nonReentrant mutex.
AToken.redeem burns tokens then re-enters the pool via redeemUnderlying, which transfers funds afterwards.
borrow reads user collateral, borrow and fee data from the data provider.
borrow updates reserve and user state through updateStateOnBorrow.
borrow transfers the borrowed amount to the user.
borrow reads the origination fee from the fee provider.
borrow emits block.timestamp in the Borrow event.
borrow is guarded by the nonReentrant mutex.
repay updates reserve and user state through updateStateOnRepay.
repay forwards origination fees to the fee collection address.
repay sends the repaid principal back to the reserve through transferToReserve.
repay emits block.timestamp in the Repay event.
repay is guarded by the nonReentrant mutex.
swapBorrowRateMode moves principal between stable and variable total borrows.
swapBorrowRateMode emits block.timestamp in the Swap event.
swapBorrowRateMode is guarded by the nonReentrant mutex.
rebalanceStableBorrowRate rebalances the user borrow through core state updates.
rebalanceStableBorrowRate emits block.timestamp in the Swap event.
rebalanceStableBorrowRate is guarded by the nonReentrant mutex.
setUserUseReserveAsCollateral verifies the balance decrease is allowed.
setUserUseReserveAsCollateral writes the collateral flag on the core.
The collateral flag is stored in usersReserveData.
setUserUseReserveAsCollateral is guarded by the nonReentrant mutex.
liquidationCall delegatecalls the liquidation manager, executing untrusted external code that can re-enter the pool.
liquidationCall ultimately mutates state through updateStateOnLiquidation.
liquidationCall resolves the liquidation manager address from the addresses provider.
liquidationCall is guarded by the nonReentrant mutex.
flashLoan transfers funds to the receiver before the receiver callback returns and before liquidity is verified.
flashLoan reads total and protocol fee bips from the parameters provider.
flashLoan accounts the fee income through updateStateOnFlashLoan.
flashLoan emits block.timestamp in the FlashLoan event.
flashLoan is guarded by the nonReentrant mutex.
initialize is protected by the initializer modifier.
initialize stores the core contract address.
initialize stores the data provider address.
updateStateOnDeposit updates reserve cumulative indexes.
updateStateOnRedeem updates reserve cumulative indexes.
updateStateOnBorrow updates total borrows by rate mode.
updateStateOnBorrow updates user borrow state.
updateStateOnBorrow refreshes reserve interest rates and timestamp.
updateStateOnRepay adjusts reserve total borrows.
updateStateOnRepay adjusts the user principal and fees.
updateStateOnRepay refreshes reserve interest rates and timestamp.
updateStateOnLiquidation updates principal and collateral reserve data.
updateStateOnLiquidation updates the liquidated user principal.
updateStateOnLiquidation refreshes reserve interest rates and timestamp.
updateStateOnFlashLoan refreshes reserve interest rates after compounding the fee.
Reserve lastUpdateTimestamp is set from block.timestamp, making rates time-dependent.
transferToUser uses a low-level call with value and fixed gas to send ETH.
transferToReserve refunds excess ETH via a low-level call.
transferToFeeCollectionAddress sends ETH fees via a low-level call.
transferToUser uses SafeERC20 for ERC20 transfers.
transferToReserve uses SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom.
transferToFeeCollectionAddress uses SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom.
callOptionalReturn performs a raw low-level call on the token address.
Allowance updates inside SafeERC20 use checked arithmetic on token amounts.
setUserUseReserveAsCollateral writes usersReserveData[user][reserve].useAsCollateral.
initReserve initializes the ReserveData struct.
initReserve appends the reserve to reservesList.
The core fallback requires msg.sender to be a contract, which can be bypassed during construction.
_fallback delegates execution to _delegate.
_delegate performs a delegatecall to the implementation using all gas.
_delegate reads the implementation slot through the _implementation accessor.
_setImplementation writes the implementation slot with assembly sstore.
_setImplementation targets IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
_setAdmin writes the admin slot with assembly sstore.
_setAdmin targets ADMIN_SLOT.
_admin reads ADMIN_SLOT with assembly sload.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls attacker-influenced data after the implementation is upgraded.
upgradeToAndCall first sets the new implementation address.
updateImplInternal deploys and initializes a new component proxy.
updateImplInternal upgrades an existing component through upgradeToAndCall.
updateImplInternal stores the new proxy address in AddressStorage.
Proxy initialize sets the implementation address.
InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize sets the implementation address.
initialize delegatecalls caller-supplied init data on the implementation.
AToken._transfer delegates the real work to executeTransferInternal.
AToken._transfer is constrained by the whenTransferAllowed health check.
redeem cumulates the caller balance before burning.
redeem burns the redeemed amount of aTokens.
redeem ultimately calls the nonReentrant pool entrypoint redeemUnderlying.
executeTransferInternal cumulates balances of both sender and receiver.
executeTransferInternal performs the underlying ERC20 balance transfer.
cumulateBalanceInternal computes the balance increase via balanceOf.
cumulateBalanceInternal mints the accrued interest as new tokens.
cumulateBalanceInternal refreshes the user index.
redirectInterestStreamInternal cumulates the source balance first.
redirectInterestStreamInternal writes the new redirection address.
redirectInterestStream resolves the caller and delegates to internal redirection.
redirectInterestStream redirects the interest of msg.sender.
allowInterestRedirectionTo writes the caller's redirection allowance.
balanceOf uses the user index to accrue interest.
balanceOf includes the user redirected balance.
balanceOf accrues using the normalized income of the underlying asset.
mintOnDeposit cumulates the account balance before minting.
mintOnDeposit mints aTokens 1:1 with the deposit.
calculateUserGlobalData derives the health factor from aggregate balances.
calculateUserGlobalData reads the price oracle through the addresses provider.
calculateUserGlobalData iterates over core reserves and configuration.
balanceDecreaseAllowed relies on the global user data computation.
balanceDecreaseAllowed recomputes the health factor after the prospective decrease.
Health factor uses wadDiv/rayDiv scaling that can round in unexpected ways.
Health factor multiplies collateral and threshold values with ray math.
Compounded interest depends on block.timestamp minus the last update timestamp.
Compounded interest is derived from miner-influenced time delta.
Compounded interest uses rayMul and rayPow exponentiation.
Compounded interest divides the rate by SECONDS_PER_YEAR with ray math.
Linear interest depends on block.timestamp minus the last update timestamp.
Linear interest is derived from miner-influenced time delta.
Linear interest scales the rate by the time delta using rayMul.
Linear interest normalizes the time delta with rayDiv.
getCompoundedBorrowBalance uses the compounded interest formula for the user rate.
getCompoundedBorrowBalance uses linear and compounded index math.
getCompoundedBorrowBalance reads the user reserve borrow state.
ERC20 transfer moves funds belonging to msg.sender.
ERC20 transfer delegates to the internal balance transfer.
transferFrom spends the caller allowance and moves the sender balance.
transferFrom delegates to the internal balance transfer.
transferFrom reads and updates the allowance mapping.
transferFrom subtracts the amount from the allowance with SafeMath.
Internal transfer updates sender and recipient balances.
Balance subtraction is guarded by SafeMath.sub.
Balance addition is guarded by SafeMath.add.
Mint increases the total supply.
Mint increases the account balance.
Mint uses SafeMath.add on supply and balance.
Burn decreases the total supply.
Burn decreases the account balance.
Burn uses SafeMath.sub which can revert on underflow.
SafeMath.add guards raw arithmetic against overflow.
SafeMath.sub guards raw arithmetic against underflow.
SafeMath.mul guards raw arithmetic against overflow.
rayMul adds the half-unit rounding constant with SafeMath.
rayMul uses checked multiplication before division.
rayMul divides by RAY to normalize the result.
rayDiv subtracts/normalizes values with SafeMath.
rayDiv multiplies the numerator by RAY with SafeMath.
nonReentrant increments and compares the guard counter to detect re-entrancy.
The guard counter increment _guardCounter += 1 is plain unchecked arithmetic.
onlyOwner reads the stored owner address.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender to the owner.
initializer compares and stores the revision number.
initializer toggles the initializing flag around the call.
transferOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
renounceOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership sets the owner to the zero address.
The receiver parameter is invoked with executeOperation after funds are transferred.
The data parameter is delegatecalled by upgradeToAndCall.
The new implementation address is written to the implementation slot.
The borrow amount feeds liquidity, collateral and fee arithmetic.
The borrower address defines whose debt is reduced and enables third-party repayment.
The reserve address identifies which liquidity is paid out during redemption.
amountToRedeem is derived from the UINT_MAX_VALUE sentinel and the current balance.
The pre-flashloan liquidity snapshot is compared against the post-callback balance.
localCounter is compared to the guard counter to detect nested calls.
paybackAmount combines compounded borrow balance, origination fee and user amount.
The post-decrease health factor decides whether the transfer is blocked.

normalization_plan.reason: The receiver parameter is only meaningful inside flashLoan where it is called as an external contract.
The arbitrary calldata parameter is delegatecalled directly by upgradeToAndCall.
The implementation address parameter is consumed only when writing the implementation slot.
The borrow amount parameter is used only within borrow for liquidity, collateral and fee checks.
The on-behalf-of address parameter is used only inside repay for debt attribution and authorization.
The reserve parameter in the redeem path selects the reserve liquidity being paid out.
The effective redeem amount is a local computation inside redeem derived from UINT_MAX_VALUE handling.
The liquidity snapshot is a flashLoan-local variable used for the post-callback balance check.
The counter snapshot exists solely inside the nonReentrant modifier to detect re-entrancy.
The computed repayment amount is local to repay and drives fee and principal transfers.
The recomputed health factor is local to balanceDecreaseAllowed and determines the boolean result.
